input.headline: Critical flaw in Examplar Edge Gateway lets attackers bypass OIDC checks
input.summary: Examplar Networks fixed a critical authentication bypass in Edge Gateway. The flaw lets an attacker present an unsigned ID token. Version 5.2.8 fixes it.

claims.text: The flaw is tracked as CVE-2026-41234 and rated 9.8 on CVSS v3.1.
claims.quote: tracked as CVE-2026-41234 and rated 9.8 on the CVSS v3.1 scale

claims.text: The gateway trusted the algorithm header supplied by the client.
claims.quote: gateway "trusted the alg header supplied by the client"

claims.text: Examplar says version 5.2.8, published on 22 September, fixes the validation logic.
claims.quote:
Examplar said version 5.2.8, published on
  22 September, corrects the validation logic.

claims.text: Northwind Security found 1,200 internet-facing instances running an affected version in a scan on 20 September.
claims.quote: Northwind Security said it found 1,200 internet-facing Edge Gateway instances running an affected version during a scan on 20 September.

claims.text: Examplar confirmed active exploitation in the wild.
claims.quote: Examplar confirmed the flaw is being actively exploited in the wild
Northwind Security said it found 1,200 internet-facing Edge Gateway instances

claims.text: Customers who cannot upgrade should enable strict_jwks.
claims.quote: customers who cannot upgrade should set the strict_jwks option to true

claims.text: The flaw affects all versions of Edge Gateway.
